milestones.description: Uses count_in_box_at_most(kind=block, object=pink_tulip, max_count=2) because the scene starts with 3 pink tulips placed at known positions. After mining at least one, at most 2 remain. This rule persists even after the tulip is crafted into dye (the block is permanently removed from the world). A generous box (min=[1,-1,0] to max=[7,1,6]) encloses all 3 tulip positions with padding.

Uses inventory_has(emerald, min_count=1) because the player starts with no emeralds and the only source of emeralds in this scene is the Dye Merchant villager's trade (1 pink_dye → 1 emerald). Having an emerald in inventory unambiguously proves the player successfully sold pink dye to the villager.
